clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
as President of the United States it is 
ordered that the second sentence of sec­
tion 3 of Executive Order No. 19159 of 
September 8,1950 (15 F.R. 6103), be, and 
it is hereby, amended to read as follows: 
“ Each member of the board (including 
the chairman) shall be appointed for a 
term of not more than three years, the 
terms of office to be fixed in such manner 
as to minimize the concurrent expiration 
of tenures of office, and may be reap­
pointed for one or more additional terms 
of not more than three years each.”

Executive Order 10803
PROVIDING FOR THE TERMS OF OF­
FICE OF THE MEMBERS OF THE  
INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT  
ADVISORY BOARD
By virtue of the authority vested in me 
as President of the United States it is 
ordered that the second sentence of sec­
tion 3 of Executive Order No. 19159 of 
September 8,1950 (15 F.R. 6103), be, and 
it is hereby, amended to read as follows: 
“ Each member of the board (including 
the chairman) shall be appointed for a 
term of not more than three years, the 
terms of office to be fixed in such manner 
as to minimize the concurrent expiration 
of tenures of office, and may be reap­
pointed for one or more additional terms 
of not more than three years each.”
D w ig h t D. E is e n h o w e r
T h e W h it e H o u se,
February 2, 1959.
[F.R. Doc. 59-1100; Filed, Feb. 4, 1959;
8:48 a.m.]
